items.title: The first 21 chapters of Quarterback of the Future are available
items.text: For the 25th anniversary of the launch of PFT, I decided to post the rewritten Quarterback of the Future — one chapter per day.

items.title: Josh Allen is one score away from four straight seasons with 12 or more rushing touchdowns
items.text: Bills quarterback Josh Allen has become something that few quarterbacks are — a rushing-touchdown machine.

items.title: Jaylen Harrell allegedly assaulted rideshare driver before crash
items.text: The Titans announced on Saturday that defensive end Jaylen Harrell was hospitalized in Tampa after a "serious car accident."

items.title: After loss to Virginia, Bill Belichick's bowl hopes come down to NC State game
items.text: It all comes down to next Saturday, potentially.

items.title: Loss to Cincinnati eliminates Deion Sanders, Colorado from bowl eligibility
items.text: Deion Sanders's fourth season at Colorado will end without a bowl game.

items.title: Knee surgery complicates Puka Nacua's future
items.text: Timeline for recovery make mean he won't be 100 percent before free agency.

items.title: NFC North continues its historic dominance
items.text: They're 27-10 overall, and 21-4 in games outside the division.

items.title: Aidan Hutchinson wasn't fined for sack that injured Drake Maye
items.text: As expected, Lions defensive end Aidan Hutchinson wasn't fined for the tackle that may have ended Patriots quarterback Drake Maye's season.

items.title: Kyren Williams has a toe injury, is expected to be ready for Wednesday
items.text: Another key offensive player for the Rams is dealing with an injury, but it is not expected to keep him from playing against the Packers on Thanksgiving Eve.

items.title: CeeDee Lamb fined $23,882 for block the league used as a highlight
items.text: Lamb was praised for the block by the league's website and by Tom Brady, but the disciplinary process said he used his helmet.

items.title: Bengals rule out Dalton Risner, list Dax Hill and Dylan Fairchild as questionable
items.text: The Bengals may be without both of their starting guards on Monday night.

items.title: 49ers waive WR Brandin Cooks
items.text: The 49ers announced a couple of roster moves ahead of Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City.

items.title: Panthers activate CB Mike Jackson
items.text: Cornerback Mike Jackson declared himself ready to return to action earlier this week and the Panthers officially added him to the roster on Saturday.

items.title: Lions place Cade Mays on injured reserve
items.text: The Lions placed center Cade Mays on injured reserve for the second time this season on Saturday.

items.title: Commanders list Jacory Croskey-Merritt, Rachaad White as questionable for Monday
items.text: The Commanders have a pair of running backs with questionable designations for Monday night's game against the Bengals.

items.title: Eagles put LB Zack Baun, WR Dontayvion Wicks on IR
items.text: The Eagles won't have linebacker Zack Baun and wide receiver Dontayvion Wicks for their next four games.

items.title: Steelers activate WR Roman Wilson
items.text: Wide receiver Roman Wilson will be back in the Steelers' lineup for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

items.title: Raiders owner Mark Davis hated the Madden movie
items.text: Did anyone read the script before allowing the Raiders' name and logo to be used?

items.text: After the 2025 season ended, Colts owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon put both G.M.

items.title: Titans place RB Tyjae Spears on injured reserve
items.text: The Titans have placed running back Tyjae Spears on injured reserve, the team announced.

items.title: Cowboys place CB DaRon Bland on injured reserve
items.text: Cowboys cornerback DaRon Bland injured an ankle in Sunday's loss to the 49ers.

items.title: NFL didn't know Puka Nacua had surgery when agreeing to suspension
items.text: The sudden decision of the NFL to suspend receiver Puka Nacua three games raises plenty of relevant questions.

items.title: Jerry Jones on fan's death after fight at 49ers-Cowboys game: "We had no record of an incident"
items.text: This week, a fan died after falling during a fight at AT&T Stadium.

items.title: Cardinals downgrade Carson Beck to out; Josh Johnson will start
items.text: As expected, Cardinals rookie quarterback Carson Beck won't be making his second career start on Sunday at Kansas City.

items.title: 49ers WR Mike Evans is "set for his return" on Sunday
items.text: Evans last played in Week 6, due to an Achilles injury.

items.title: Jaguars saw something in Liam Coen that other teams didn't
items.text: The Jaguars identified Coen as their No. 1 candidate and re-shaped their front office to get him, at a time when other teams weren't even interviewing him.

items.title: Titans DE Jaylen Harrell is hospitalized after "serious car accident"
items.text: Titans defensive end Jaylen Harrell has been involved in a "serious car accident."

items.title: Bills add Ed Oliver to injury report, list him as questionable
items.text: The Bills made a late addition to their injury report for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

items.title: Steelers rule out Nick Herbig
items.text: The Steelers will not have linebacker Nick Herbig against the Eagles.

items.title: Tom Brady, after selling Birmingham City stake, buys piece of Chelsea
items.text: Tom Brady's exit from the English soccer business was only temporary.
